text:
mia_partnerships: Heads-up: new cloud marketplace onboarding for partner Acme AI. Need to align on portal access, KMS ownership, trial SKU schema, and any GCP reviewer quirks. Can we triage before EOD?

carlos_pm: Yep. I have the partner's timeline: they want listing up next week. Priority: get IAM role + manifest validated asap.

lina_legal: quick note  GCP reviewers require explicit telemetry opt-in language in the UI and a fallback in the EULA for EU customers. i'll draft two short options and post here.

tom_eng: For portal role, i'd prefer we do a cross-account readonly role with an inline policy limited to the manifest bucket and object-get. sample policy I'll paste:```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "s3:GetObject",
        "s3:ListBucket"
      ],
      "Resource": [
        "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-marketplace-assets/*",
        "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-marketplace-assets"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

mia_partnerships: thanks. who owns KMS key for manifest encryption? we need a rotation window and contact for key policy edits.

carlos_pm: ops will own the key; i'll DM @devops to confirm rotation schedule. we typically do 90-day rotation for marketplace keys.

lina_legal: draft telemetry UI copy: "Allow Redwood to collect anonymous usage metrics to improve product performance. You can opt out at any time from Settings." EULA snippet: "Anonymous telemetry may be used for service improvement; customers in the EU may request deletion of telemetry data associated with their tenancy." thoughts?

tom_eng: good start. add that telemetry won't be used for training third-party models. that was a flag in prior reviews.

mia_partnerships: SKU naming: partner suggests `acme-ai-pro-trial-14d`. we prefer prefixing with `rw-` for internal tracking. propose `rw-acme-pro-trial-14d` and `rw-acme-startup-trial-14d`.

carlos_pm: agree on `rw-` prefix. note: marketplace has character limits (max 50). keep short.

marketplace_bot: Reminder: manifest validator requires `sku_id`, `display_name`, `pricing_type`, and `support_contact` fields. Upload to s3://redwood-marketplace-manifests/ACME-001/ by 6pm for same-day validation. Docs: https://internal.docs/marketplace/validator

lina_legal: also, ensure support_contact is a monitored alias (not a personal inbox). reviewers ping that often.

tom_eng: i'll strip any internal endpoints from the manifest and replace with placeholder URLs before upload. also will add a kmsEncrypted: true flag.

mia_partnerships: next steps: tom to create role & scrub manifest, carlos to confirm ops key owner and rotation cadence, lina to finalize two telemetry drafts (UI + EULA), me to coordinate upload and rep intro. i'll schedule a 20m sync if validator returns errors.

carlos_pm: adding partner rep @acme-marketplace to thread after validator pass.

mia_partnerships: thanks team. i'll follow up in this thread with the upload link and validator result. :shipit:

marketplace_bot: Validation queued for s3://redwood-marketplace-manifests/ACME-001/manifest.yaml  status: queued
